description: This file contains the implementation of the Subscription controller class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for listing subscriptions, viewing details, and other subscription-related actions in the user's account area.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class handling user subscription-related actions, including listing, viewing subscription details, and managing subscriptions within the account namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the list of subscriptions for the logged-in user, with pagination, breadcrumbs, and associated data.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific subscription, including status, associated product, address, and relevant dates.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Prepares and displays the history of status changes and comments for a specific subscription, with pagination.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the history entries for a specific subscription, based on subscription ID and pagination parameters.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Prepares and displays the order details related to a subscription.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves order details associated with a subscription, including order ID, status, total, date, and links for viewing.
